headline: If You Invested $1000 In Walmart Stock 5 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
summary: Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT) has outperformed the market over the past 5 years by 5.97% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 17.3%. Currently, Walmart has a market capitalization of $865.10 billion.
